arguments.new_string:
The decorated function exposes its internal cache dictionary as ``.memory``.
    Entries contain ``(result, timestamp)`` pairs. It also exposes ``.skip`` as
    :class:`SkipMemoization`: raising ``api_call.skip(value)`` returns ``value``
    without caching it, just as with :func:`@memoize<memoize>`.

    Cache can be invalidated before timeout with::

@reraise(requests.RequestsError, MyAPIError)
        def api_call(...):
            # ...

    ``into`` can be an exception class or instance, or a callable receiving the
    caught exception and returning the new exception to raise::

        with reraise(ValueError, lambda error: MyAPIError(str(error))):
            # ...
